questions.prompt: What is the main claim of `Correcting Predictions`?
choices: Better forecasts come from disciplined correction rather than from intuition worship
The chapter promises perfect prediction
Confidence alone is enough to improve forecasts

explanation.direct: Correct. It argues that structured correction improves prediction more than faith in instinct alone.
explanation.competitive: Right. The chapter makes the room revise the forecast instead of worshiping the hunch.
